correctness.rationale: Starting from the source's exact optimizer equation \(1-1/x-\log(x/\kappa)=0\), putting \(y=1/x>1\) gives \(y-\log y=1+\log\kappa\), equivalently \((-y)e^{-y}=-1/(e\kappa)\). The interval \(y>1\) selects \(w=W_{-1}(-1/(e\kappa))=-y\), and substitution yields the displayed \(\theta_\kappa\) and minimum. Independent symbolic series inversion reproduced \(y=1+q+q^2/3+q^3/36-q^4/270+\cdots\) for \(q=\sqrt{2\log\kappa}\), hence the package's \(\theta\) and \(m\) expansions; the standard large-branch relation gives \(y-1=\log\kappa+\log\log\kappa+o(1)\) and \(1-m\sim1/(e\kappa\log\kappa)\).

Substituting \(y=1/x\) gives \(y-\log y=1+\log\kappa\), hence \(-y=W_{-1}(-1/(e\kappa))\) by the defining equation of Lambert \(W\). The claimed endpoint expansions then follow from the standard branch-point and large-argument expansions recorded in DLMF §4.13. Under the required implication standard, the full audited claim is a routine closed-form repackaging and asymptotic expansion of the source's implicit optimizer.
